_note: Fully current reservoir readings are held by the utilities and water departments, which release them about once a month. Set a feed per city: either put the department's CSV into data/govt_drop/<city>.csv (columns: reservoir,date,storage_pct; an ALL row gives total system storage) or set feed.url to an endpoint they provide (feed.auth_env names an environment variable holding an Authorization header value). The backend checks every poll cycle (default 20 minutes) and ingests only when the content changed.
